Furthermore, due to terrain restrictions, exactly one of the following two links must be part of the circuit: the link between Beta and Gamma, or the link between Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal‑length closed inspection route that visits every outpost precisely once and returns to the starting outpost.
